title: Message Router Get_Attributes_All over SendRRData
purpose: Provide a valid unconnected explicit message using SendRRData carrying a small Message Router request with service 0x01 and a class plus instance style path.
expected_behavior: The target should parse the outer SendRRData frame and CPF items, then attempt to dispatch a Get_Attributes_All Message Router request at CIP level.
constraints_preserved: Encapsulation length is 0x0018 and matches the 24-byte command-specific payload.
The SendRRData command-specific prefix contains interface handle 0 and timeout 0.
CPF uses the documented SendRRData item combination of Null Address Item and Unconnected Data Item.
Unconnected Data Item length is 8 and matches the embedded CIP request.
Service byte 0x01 is the documented Get_Attributes_All code.
Path-size byte is 0x02, matching two 16-bit words of path data.
issue_safety_notes: Depth comes from valid nested structure only; no malformed recursion or unsupported issue claim is included.
